s: Routes, deduplicates, groups, and escalates alerts into human-paging workflows with silences and rotations.
w: Consumes alert events from metric/log/trace rules; grouping collapses storms into single notifications; inhibition suppresses dependents when roots fire; routing tables map severities/teams to channels (PagerDuty/Slack/email); silences mute during maintenance; escalation chains page backups after non-ack windows.
use: On-call paging for SLO burn-rate breaches
pits: Alert fatigue from noisy thresholds - burn-rate windows over static thresholds
Missing ownership mapping - alerts must route to teams not /dev/null
tips: Multi-window burn-rate alerting reference (Google SRE workbook) earns credibility
